# Quest Construction

> Quest Construction LLC is a family-owned general contractor working across
> 34 cities in Arizona. Founded 2018.
> 14 trades, all self-managed rather than brokered out.
> Reachable 24/7 on (602) 399-6455.

Quest builds and remodels residential property: new custom homes and residential
development, casitas and ADUs, full interior remodels, and the exterior envelope —
roofing, stucco, siding, windows and decks. The same crew carries a job from first
conversation through final walkthrough, which is the point of hiring one contractor
rather than co-ordinating several.

- Founded: 2018
- Phone: (602) 399-6455 (24/7)
- Region: Arizona, USA
- Positioning: Local, family-owned experts in quality building solutions

## Services

- [Residential Development](https://questconstruction.com/services/residential-development/): Transforming your vision into a dream home with expert craftsmanship.
- [Casita](https://questconstruction.com/services/casita/): Custom small homes expertly designed to complement any lifestyle.
- [ADU](https://questconstruction.com/services/adu/): Enhance space and add value with your dream detached unit.
- [Framing](https://questconstruction.com/services/framing/): Expertly shaping your structure's foundation with precision and skill.
- [Concrete](https://questconstruction.com/services/concrete/): Durable, expertly crafted concrete solutions tailored to your project's needs.
- [Stucco](https://questconstruction.com/services/stucco/): Enhance your home's exterior with durable, attractive stucco finish.
- [Dry Wall](https://questconstruction.com/services/dry-wall/): Expertly finishes, seamless installations, perfect for any interior project.
- [Siding](https://questconstruction.com/services/siding/): Enhance curb appeal and protect your home with expert siding.
- [Roofing](https://questconstruction.com/services/roofing/): Protect your home with reliable, durable, and expert roofing solutions.
- [Full Remodel](https://questconstruction.com/services/full-remodel-kitchen-bathroomcabinets-flooring-counter-tops/): Transform your space with expert craftsmanship and modern design.
- [Custom Home Building](https://questconstruction.com/services/custom-home-building/): Crafting your dream home with precision, style, and reliability.
- [Painting](https://questconstruction.com/services/painting/): Transforming spaces with vibrant colors and exceptional precision.
- [Deck Building](https://questconstruction.com/services/deck-building-uses-trex-system/): Transform your outdoor spaces with our top-quality Trex decking.
- [Window Installation](https://questconstruction.com/services/window-installation/): Enhance your home's energy efficiency with expert window installation.

## The Build Log

Written advice about doing this work in this climate, not company news.

- [Shade first: what a pergola actually changes](https://questconstruction.com/blog/shade-first-what-a-pergola-changes/) — Outdoor living, 2026-08-11: A shade structure is the cheapest change you can make to how a west-facing room behaves in July.
- [What a monsoon actually does to a roof](https://questconstruction.com/blog/what-a-monsoon-does-to-an-arizona-roof/) — Roofing, 2026-07-14: The leak is almost never where the water came in, and almost always where somebody patched something years ago.
- [Who issues your permit, and why it moves the date](https://questconstruction.com/blog/who-issues-your-building-permit/) — Permits, 2026-06-02: Two houses four miles apart can be two applications, to two authorities, on two timetables.
- [Tile roofs do not wear out. The underlayment does.](https://questconstruction.com/blog/tile-roofs-and-the-underlayment-underneath/) — Roofing, 2026-05-19: The tile is a rain screen and a sunshade. The thing keeping water out of the house is underneath it, and it has a much shorter life.
- [Matching stucco that has been in the sun for forty years](https://questconstruction.com/blog/matching-forty-year-old-stucco/) — Stucco, 2026-04-07: The reason an addition looks like an addition is almost never the framing. It is a texture that was matched off a sample board.
- [Bearing wall or partition: the question that prices a kitchen](https://questconstruction.com/blog/bearing-wall-or-partition/) — Remodeling, 2026-03-24: Two walls that look identical from the kitchen side can be a day of work apart, or several thousand dollars.

## Notes

- Quest has not published a street address, a licence number or a review score,
  so none appears on the site or in its structured data.
- Photography outside the three images marked as Quest's own is stock standing
  in for jobsite photographs; the gallery page says so on the page.
